questions.question: Gautam started a business with a sum of ₹ 60,000. Jatin joined him 8 months later with a sum of ₹ 35,000. At what respective ratio will the two share the profit after two years?
questions.questionHtml: Gautam started a business with a sum of ₹ 60,000. Jatin joined him 8 months later with a sum of ₹ 35,000. At what respective ratio will the two share the profit after two years?
questions.solution:
Gautam's contribution ⇒ 60,000 × 24 = 1,440,000

Jatin's contribution ⇒ 35,000 × 16 = 560,000

Profit sharing ratio ⇒ 1,440,000 : 560,000 = 144 : 56 = 18 : 7

questions.question: The average weight of 12 people is 65 kg. If one person leaves and the new average becomes 64.5 kg, what is the weight of the person who left?
questions.questionHtml: The average weight of 12 people is 65 kg. If one person leaves and the new average becomes 64.5 kg, what is the weight of the person who left?
questions.solution:
Total weight (before leaving) ⇒ 65 × 12 = 780 kg

Total weight (after leaving) ⇒ 64.5 × 11 = 709.5 kg

Weight of the person who left ⇒ 780 − 709.5 = 70.5 kg

questions.question: Table - Monthly Sales (in ₹1000) Sales Person Jan Feb March April P 50 60 70 55 Q 65 68 62 64 The average monthly sales of Q?
questions.questionHtml:
Table - Monthly Sales (in ₹1000)

Sales Person  Jan  Feb  March  April 
P 50 60 70 55
Q 65 68 62 64

The average monthly sales of Q?
questions.solution:
Sales of Q in Jan = 65, Feb = 68, Mar = 62, Apr = 64.

⇒ Total sales = 65 + 68 + 62 + 64 = 259.

⇒ Average = 259 ÷ 4 = 64.75.

questions.question: The ratio of the profit to the cost price of a product is 2: 7. What is the ratio of its selling price to its profit?
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of the profit to the cost price of a product is 2: 7. What is the ratio of its selling price to its profit?
questions.solution:
Let CP = 7x and Profit = 2x.

SP = CP + Profit = 7x + 2x = 9x.

Ratio of SP to Profit = SP ÷ Profit = 9x ÷ 2x = 9:2.

<svg width="450" height="280" viewBox="0 0 450 280" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

questions.question: A metal sphere having a radius of 10 centimeters is melted down and molded into 8 identical smaller solid spheres. What is the ratio of the surface area of the original sphere to the total surface area of all 8 smaller spheres?
questions.questionHtml: A metal sphere having a radius of 10 centimeters is melted down and molded into 8 identical smaller solid spheres. What is the ratio of the surface area of the original sphere to the total surface area of all 8 smaller spheres?
questions.solution:
⇒ Volume of original sphere = (4 ÷ 3) × π × 103 = (4 ÷ 3) × π × 1000

⇒ Volume of 8 smaller spheres = 8 × (4 ÷ 3) × π × r3, so 1000 = 8r3, r3 = 125, r = 5

⇒ Surface area of original sphere = 4 × π × 102 = 400π

⇒ Surface area of one smaller sphere = 4 × π × 52 = 100π

⇒ Total surface area of 8 smaller spheres = 8 × 100π = 800π

⇒ Required ratio = 400π : 800π = 1 : 2

questions.question: How many hemispheres with a radius of 3 cm can be produced by melting down a hemisphere with a radius of 12 cm?
questions.questionHtml: How many hemispheres with a radius of 3 cm can be produced by melting down a hemisphere with a radius of 12 cm?
questions.solution:
Volume of larger hemisphere = (2 ÷ 3) × π × 123 = 1152π

Volume of one smaller hemisphere = (2 ÷ 3) × π × 33 = 18π

Number of smaller hemispheres = 1152π ÷ 18π = 64

questions.question: A cylinder and hemisphere have the same radius. Their combined height is 30 cm. If the cylinder and hemisphere have equal volumes, find the radius.
questions.questionHtml: A cylinder and hemisphere have the same radius. Their combined height is 30 cm. If the cylinder and hemisphere have equal volumes, find the radius.
questions.solution:
Let height of hemisphere = r and height of cylinder = 30 − r.

Volume of cylinder = π × r2 × (30 − r), Volume of hemisphere = (2 ÷ 3) × π × r3.

π × r2 × (30 − r) = (2 ÷ 3) × π × r3 ⇒ r2 × (30 − r) = (2 ÷ 3) × r3.

30 − r = (2 ÷ 3) × r ⇒ 30 = r + (2 ÷ 3)r ⇒ 30 = (5 ÷ 3)r ⇒ r = 30 × (3 ÷ 5) = 18 cm.

questions.question: A pyramid has a base area of 60 cm² and height 9 cm. What is its volume?
questions.questionHtml: A pyramid has a base area of 60 cm² and height 9 cm. What is its volume?
questions.solution:
Volume = (1/3) × Base area × Height

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × 60 × 9

⇒ Volume = 20 × 9 = 180 cm³

questions.question: In triangle ABC, medians AD, BE, and CF intersect at the centroid G. What is the ratio of the area of triangle GAB to the area of triangle ABC?
questions.questionHtml: In triangle ABC, medians AD, BE, and CF intersect at the centroid G. What is the ratio of the area of triangle GAB to the area of triangle ABC?
questions.solution:
⇒ Medians AD, BE, and CF intersect at G, forming 6 triangles of equal area.

⇒ Area of triangle GAB = 2 × (Area of triangle ABC ÷ 6) = Area of triangle ABC ÷ 3.

⇒ Required ratio = (Area of triangle ABC ÷ 3) : (Area of triangle ABC) = 1 : 3.

questions.question: In △ABC, a line segment DE is parallel to BC, with D on AB and E on AC. If the ratio of the area of △ADE to the area of the trapezoid DECB is 4:21, what is the ratio of AD to DB?
questions.questionHtml: In △ABC, a line segment DE is parallel to BC, with D on AB and E on AC. If the ratio of the area of △ADE to the area of the trapezoid DECB is 4:21, what is the ratio of AD to DB?
questions.solution:
Let Area of △ADE = 4x, Area of trapezoid DECB = 21x.

Area of △ABC = 4x + 21x = 25x.

Area ratio of △ADE to △ABC = 4 ÷ 25 ⇒ (AD ÷ AB)2 = 4 ÷ 25 ⇒ AD ÷ AB = 2 ÷ 5.

AB = AD + DB ⇒ AD ÷ (AD + DB) = 2 ÷ 5 ⇒ 5AD = 2AD + 2DB ⇒ 3AD = 2DB ⇒ AD ÷ DB = 2 ÷ 3.

questions.question: A right triangle has sides 3, 4, and 5. A smaller triangle is drawn inside it with its vertices on the sides of the larger triangle, such that it is similar to the larger triangle. If its perimeter is 6, what is its area?
questions.questionHtml: A right triangle has sides 3, 4, and 5. A smaller triangle is drawn inside it with its vertices on the sides of the larger triangle, such that it is similar to the larger triangle. If its perimeter is 6, what is its area?
questions.solution:
⇒ Perimeter of larger triangle = 3 + 4 + 5 = 12

⇒ Ratio of similarity = 6 ÷ 12 = 1 ÷ 2

⇒ Area of smaller triangle = 6 × (1 ÷ 2)2 = 6 × (1 ÷ 4) = 1.5

questions.question: The distance between the centers of two circles is d. The lengths of their direct and transverse common tangents are L and M, respectively. If L 2 + M 2 = 200 and the sum of the squares of their radii is 100, what is the value of d?
questions.questionHtml: The distance between the centers of two circles is d. The lengths of their direct and transverse common tangents are L and M, respectively. If L<sup>2</sup> + M<sup>2</sup> = 200 and the sum of the squares of their radii is 100, what is the value of d?
questions.solution:
L2 + M2 = 2d2 − [(R − r)2 + (R + r)2]

(R − r)2 + (R + r)2 = 2(R2 + r2) = 200

200 = 2d2 − 200 ⇒ 2d2 = 400 ⇒ d2 = 200

⇒ d = √200 = 10√2

questions.question: There are two parallel chords measuring 16 cm and 12 cm, both situated on the same side of the center of a circle. The space between the two chords is 2 cm. What is the radius of the circle?
questions.questionHtml: There are two parallel chords measuring 16 cm and 12 cm, both situated on the same side of the center of a circle. The space between the two chords is 2 cm. What is the radius of the circle?
questions.solution:
16 = 2 × √(r2 − d12) ⇒ 8 = √(r2 − d12) ⇒ r2 − d12 = 64

12 = 2 × √(r2 − d22) ⇒ 6 = √(r2 − d22) ⇒ r2 − d22 = 36

d22 − d12 = 36 − 64 ⇒ d2 − d1 = 2 ⇒ d2 + d1 = 14

d2 = 8, d1 = 6 ⇒ r2 − 62 = 64 ⇒ r2 = 100 ⇒ r = 10 cm

questions.question: What is the area of the segment formed by a chord in a circle of radius 12 cm, if the angle subtended at the center is 150°?
questions.questionHtml: What is the area of the segment formed by a chord in a circle of radius 12 cm, if the angle subtended at the center is 150°?
questions.solution:
Area of sector = (150 ÷ 360) × π × 122

⇒ Area of sector = (5 ÷ 12) × π × 144 = 60π

Area of triangle = (1 ÷ 2) × 122 × sin150º

⇒ Area of triangle = (1 ÷ 2) × 144 × (1 ÷ 2) = 36

Area of segment = 60π − 36
